limitations: The final transition executor and renderer consumer are not mapped here.
FallRespawnData+0xe4 ownership and all other recovery producers remain incomplete.
No recovery suppression or gameplay exemption is established by these references.
The three transform writer hooks do not cover every possible direct component write or structural replacement.
